title: Turkish Aubergine Dolma
description: A flavorful and healthy Turkish-inspired dish with aubergine dolma. Serve as a side or light meal.
instructions: Cut the aubergine in half lengthwise and scoop out the seeds.
In a pan, heat the olive oil over medium heat. Add the chopped onion and cook until softened.
Add the garlic, tomato paste, and chopped dolma. Cook for 2-3 minutes.
Stuff each aubergine half with the rice mixture and season with salt and black pepper.
Place the stuffed aubergine in a baking dish and cover with foil.
Bake for 30 minutes, then remove the foil and continue baking for an additional 15 minutes.
